entities.summary: Uladzimir Prakopavich Nyaklyayew is a Belarusian poet and writer, and a former head of the public campaign Tell the Truth!. He was a candidate in the 2010 Belarusian presidential election, and, according to Amnesty International, was placed under house arrest for his role in post-election protests.
